arxiv-1907-04968.title: High-precision asteroseismology in Slowly Pulsating B star: HD 50230
arxiv-1907-04968.creator: Tao Wu and Yan Li
arxiv-1907-04968.description: Abstract SPB star HD 50230, in fact a hybrid B-type pulsator, has been observed by CoRoT least 137 days. A nearly equidistant period spacing pattern are found among 8 modes which are extracted from the oscillation spectrum with more than 500 frequencies. However, it is thought to be most likely accidental by Szewczuk et al. 2014 .

arxiv-2007-13146.title: Radio Resource Management in Joint Radar and Communication: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2007-13146.creator: Nguyen Cong Luong, Xiao Lu, Member, IEEE, Dinh Thai Hoang, Member, IEEE, Dusit Niyato, Fellow, IEEE, Dong In Kim, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2007-13146.description: Abstract Joint radar and communication (JRC) has recently attracted substantial attention. The first reason is that JRC allows individual radar and communication systems to share spectrum bands and thus improves the spectrum utilization. The second reason is that JRC enables a single hardware platform, e.g.

arxiv-2212-00128.title: An Optimized Privacy-Utility Trade-off Framework for Differentially Private Data Sharing in Blockchain-based Internet of Things
arxiv-2212-00128.creator: Muhammad Islam, Mubashir Husain Rehmani, Jinjun Chen
arxiv-2212-00128.description: Abstract Differential private (DP) query and response mechanisms have been widely adopted in various applications based on Internet of Things (IoT) to leverage variety of benefits through data analysis. The protection of sensitive information is achieved through the addition of noise into the query response which hides the individual records in a dataset.

arxiv-2302-05136.title: Ponderomotive force due to the intrinsic spin for electrostatic waves in a magnetized plasma
arxiv-2302-05136.creator: Haidar Al-Naseri, Gert Brodin
arxiv-2302-05136.description: Abstract We study the contribution from the electron spin to the ponderomotive force, using a quantum kinetic model including the spin-orbit correction. Specifically, we derive an analytical expression for the ponderomotive force, applicable for electrostatic waves propagating parallel to an external magnetic field.

arxiv-2304-07680.title: Manifold Fitting
arxiv-2304-07680.creator: Zhigang Yao ??,??, Jiaji Su, Bingjie Li, Shing-Tung Yau
arxiv-2304-07680.description: Abstract While classical data analysis has addressed observations that are real numbers or elements of a real vector space, at present many statistical problems of high interest in the sciences address the analysis of data that consist of more complex objects, taking values in spaces that are naturally not (Euclidean) vector spaces but which still feature some geometric structure.

arxiv-2305-03340.title: Reinforcement Learning for Control of Evolutionary and Ecological Processes
arxiv-2305-03340.creator: Bryce Allen Bagley, Navin Khoshnan, Claudia K Petritsch
arxiv-2305-03340.description: Abstract SUMMARY As research in evolutionary dynamics and Evolutionary Game Theory moves from the realm of theory into application in oncology, algorithms that account for physiologic variation are needed to move beyond simple models. Yet few algorithms exist that integrate these ecological and physiological factors which are central to evolution in biological systems.

arxiv-2308-12765.title: Nearly-room-temperature ferromagnetism and tunable anomalous Hall effect in atomically thin Fe 4 CoGeTe 2
arxiv-2308-12765.creator: Shaohua Yan, Hui-Hui He, Yang Fu, Ning-Ning Zhao, Shangjie Tian, Qiangwei Yin, Fanyu Meng, Xinyu Cao, Le Wang, Shanshan Chen, Ki-Hoon Son, Jun Woo Choi, Hyejin Ryu, Shouguo Wang, Xiao Zhang, Kai Liu, Hechang Lei
arxiv-2308-12765.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shaohua Yan, Hui-Hui He, Yang Fu, Ning-Ning Zhao, Shangjie Tian, Qiangwei Yin, Fanyu Meng, Xinyu Cao, Le Wang, Shanshan Chen, Ki-Hoon Son, Jun Woo Choi, Hyejin Ryu, Shouguo Wang, Xiao Zhang, Kai Liu, Hechang Lei. Itinerant ferromagnetism at room temperature is a key ingredient for spin transport and manipulation. Here, we report the realization of nearly-room-temperature itinerant ferromagnetism in Co doped Fe 5 GeTe 2 thin flakes.

arxiv-2309-12117.title: How-to Guides for Specific Audiences: A Corpus and Initial Findings
arxiv-2309-12117.creator: Nicola Fanton[-0.2em] he/they, Agnieszka FalenskaUniversity of Stuttgart, Michael Roth
arxiv-2309-12117.description: Abstract Instructional texts for specific target groups should ideally take into account the prior knowledge and needs of the readers in order to guide them efficiently to their desired goals. However, targeting specific groups also carries the risk of reflecting disparate social norms and subtle stereotypes.

arxiv-2404-07409.title: Too good to be true: People reject free gifts from robots because they infer bad intentions
arxiv-2404-07409.creator: Benjamin Lebrun, Andrew Vonasch, Christoph Bartneck
arxiv-2404-07409.description: Abstract A recent psychology study found that people sometimes reject overly generous offers from people because they imagine hidden “phantom costs” must be part of the transaction. Phantom costs occur when a person seems overly generous for no apparent reason. This study aims to explore whether people can imagine phantom costs when interacting with a robot.

arxiv-2502-03275.title: Token Assorted: Mixing Latent and Text Tokens for Improved Language Model Reasoning
arxiv-2502-03275.creator: DiJia Su, Hanlin Zhu, Yingchen Xu, Jiantao Jiao, Yuandong Tian †, Qinqing Zheng †
arxiv-2502-03275.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning and planning when trained on chain-of-thought (CoT) data, where the step-by-step thought process is explicitly outlined by text tokens. However, this results in lengthy inputs where many words support textual coherence rather than core reasoning information, and processing these inputs consumes substantial computation resources.

arxiv-2506-04689.title: Recycling the Web: A Method to Enhance Pre-training Data Quality and Quantity for Language Models
arxiv-2506-04689.creator: Thao Nguyen Yang Li Olga Golovneva, Luke Zettlemoyer Sewoong Oh Ludwig Schmidt Xian Li
arxiv-2506-04689.description: Abstract Scaling laws predict that the performance of large language models improves with increasing model size and data size. In practice, pre-training has been relying on massive web crawls, using almost all data sources publicly available on the internet so far. However, this pool of natural data does not grow at the same rate as the compute supply.

pmc-10507095.title: Non-adaptive measurement-based quantum computation on IBM Q
pmc-10507095.creator: Jelena Mackeprang, Daniel Bhatti, Stefanie Barz
pmc-10507095.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). We test the quantumness of IBM’s quantum computer IBM Quantum System One in Ehningen, Germany. We generate generalised n-qubit GHZ states and measure Bell inequalities to investigate the n-party entanglement of the GHZ states. The implemented Bell inequalities are derived from non-adaptive measurement-based quantum computation (NMQC), a type of quantum computing that links the successful computation of a non-linear function to the violation of a multipartite Bell-inequality.

pmc-11312735.title: Advances in Psychotropic Treatment for Pregnant Women: Efficacy, Adverse Outcomes, and Therapeutic Monitoring
pmc-11312735.creator: Bárbara Costa, Nuno Vale, Irina Esterlis
pmc-11312735.description: Advancements in psychotropic therapy for pregnant women are pivotal for addressing maternal mental health during the perinatal period. Screening for mood and anxiety symptoms during pregnancy is recommended to enable early intervention. Psychotropic medications, including antidepressants, benzodiazepines, antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers, are commonly used, but challenges remain regarding their safety and efficacy during pregnancy.

pmc-12504157.title: Comparative effectiveness and safety of enzalutamide versus abiraterone in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer: a nationwide registry-based cohort study from Taiwan
pmc-12504157.creator: Wen-Kuan Huang, Po-Jung Su, Chun-Chi Chen, Ching-Fu Chang, Shao-Ming Yu, Ming-Jer Hsieh, Ming-Lung Tsai, Tien-Hsing Chen, Pao-Hsien Chu, I-Chang Hsieh, See-Tong Pang, Dong-Yi Chen
pmc-12504157.description: PurposeThe real-world effectiveness and safety of abiraterone or enzalutamide in the Asian population with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) remains unclear.MethodsUsing the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database, we identified a cohort of 3056 patients diagnosed with mCRPC receiving abiraterone or enzalutamide from January 1, 2017 through April 30, 2020, followed until December 31, 2021.

pmc-12515003.title: Factors Related to Blood Transfusions in Pregnant Women Undergoing Caesarean Sections: A 20-year Retrospective Study
pmc-12515003.creator: Saifon Chawanpaiboon, Vitaya Titapant, Julaporn Pooliam
pmc-12515003.description: BackgroundThe rising rates of caesarean section (CS) globally have been associated with an increase in maternal complications, including the need for blood transfusions. Maternal anaemia, uterine atony, and placenta-related disorders contribute significantly to haemorrhagic complications during CS. This study aimed to evaluate the factors associated with blood transfusions in pregnant women undergoing CS at Siriraj Hospital over a 20-year period.

pmc-12589554.title: Care burden and outcomes in young carers during and after the COVID‑19 pandemic: psychological distress and cognitive–emotional aspects
pmc-12589554.creator: Ziyan Wang, Bing Niu
pmc-12589554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Global social and policy concerns regarding young carers’ care burden are increasing, but the outcomes of their caring responsibilities, especially in Asian countries, remain inadequately explored. We empirically examined the associations of care burden with psychological distress and cognitive–emotional aspects using cross‑sectional online surveys of young carers aged 15–19 living throughout Japan in 2021 (during the COVID‑19 pandemic) and 2024 (post‑pandemic). Each survey sampled a different group of young carers.

pmc-13028773.title: Core–Shell Metal–Organic Framework Composites: A Review of Synthetic Strategies and Applications in Catalysis and Adsorption
pmc-13028773.creator: Deyun Sun, Shangqing Chen, Haonan Wu, Mingyue Qiu, Youluan Lu, Ningyuan Wang, Qian Ma, Lijuan Shi, Qun Yi
pmc-13028773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Core–shell metal–organic framework (MOF) composites, owing to their unique structural advantages, have emerged as a prominent research focus in the field of chemistry, advanced materials and chemical engineering. By integrating MOFs with other functional components such as MOFs, covalent organic frameworks (COFs), metal oxides, carbon materials, ionic liquids or polymers into synergistic heterogeneous architectures, coreshell MOFs can markedly enhance physicochemical stability and enable diversified functional performances.

pmc-13250185.title: Use of medicinal herbs in an Iranian population: cross-sectional findings from the Fasa PERSIAN Cohort Study
pmc-13250185.creator: Seyed Hamdollah Mosavat, Alireza Kamrani Poor, Reza Homayounfar, Mohammad Mehdi Naghizadeh, Mojtaba Farjam, Neda Nayebi, Ayeh Naghizadeh, Fatemeh Amini, Mehdi Salehi, Mohammad Hashem Hashempur
pmc-13250185.description: AbstractObjectivesTo determine the prevalence, patterns and correlates of medicinal herb use in a rural Iranian population and to evaluate demographic and clinical predictors using adjusted regression models.DesignCross-sectional analysis of baseline data from the Fasa Prospective Epidemiological Research Studies in Iran Cohort Study.SettingSheshdeh, a rural district in southern Iran.Participants10 143 adults aged 35–70 years enrolled between 2017 and 2019.

pmc-13284016.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation from different pig breeds alters fat deposition and gut microbiota in mice
pmc-13284016.creator: Fan Yang, Shihao Liu, Guoqing Liu, Liming Luo, Xvyang Lu, Weimin Lin, Jing Chen, Ruiyi Lin
pmc-13284016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Gut microbiota plays a vital role in nutrient digestion, energy metabolism, and immune regulation in pigs. However, the core bacterial species influencing fat deposition remain poorly defined due to the complexity and diversity of the intestinal microbial ecosystem. In this study, healthy Putian Black (PT) pigs and Duroc × × Landrace × × Yorkshire (DLY) pigs of similar ages were used as fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) donors, with male ICR mice as recipients.

pmc-13418363.title: Green revolution breeding favored water conservation, but weakened water use sensitivity to rising vapor pressure deficit in US spring wheat
pmc-13418363.creator: Tina Koehler, Qiansu Ding, Emma Ossola, James Anderson, Andrea Carminati, Walid Sadok
pmc-13418363.description: The global rise in vapor pressure deficit (VPD) threatens crop production. Plants mitigate high VPD by regulating their transpiration rate (TR). Yield is related to TR, but whether genetic yield gains reflect shifts in TR-VPD responses remains debated. Over the last century, US spring wheat yields have tripled in the Midwest.

pmc-13677779.title: Sleep stage-specific heart rate variability feature-driven clustering analysis: identifying cardiac autonomic endotypes with long-term cardiovascular predictive value
pmc-13677779.creator: Xiao Chen, Luqi Bai, Chong Li, Boda Zhou
pmc-13677779.description: AimsCardiovascular risk assessment in obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) has traditionally relied on the Apnea–Hypopnea Index (AHI). However, AHI primarily reflects respiratory event burden and may not adequately capture inter-individual heterogeneity in sleep-related cardiorespiratory regulation. This study aimed to identify sleep stage-specific heart rate variability (HRV) phenotypes and evaluate their associations with long-term cardiovascular outcomes.
